problem: Production Source Snapshot stopped immediately when a Git-linked Netlify build returned state=error even though an authorized canonical exact-source upload fallback already existed.
root_cause: The linked-build branch only enabled fallback when error_message was exactly Skipped; other provider build errors exited 78 before canonical transport.
prevention: Always log linked deploy/build error evidence before fallback.
Any linked Netlify build state=error must continue to the canonical exact-source upload transport.
Fallback never weakens provider-ready, exact production SHA, pricing-content or browser-readback gates.
Never mark LIVE from linked-build trigger success alone.
